Sri Lanka: Timeless Heritage & Wild Sanctuary

"A Land of Timeless Cultural Heritage & Extraordinary Diversity"

Destination Overview

Embark on an extraordinary journey through mist-shrouded emerald tea estates, ancient royal kingdoms, and untouched coastal wildlife reserves. Sri Lanka is a island where 2,500 years of living history meet unmatched 5-star hospitality.

Curated 5-Star Highlights

Private Dawn Access to Sigiriya Rock Fortress with Senior Archaeologists
VIP 4x4 Jeep Tracking for Leopards & Sloth Bears in Yala & Wilpattu
Restored Colonial Planter Bungalow Stay with Private Tea Tasting
Sacred Ayurvedic Mind-Body Rejuvenation with Master Practitioners
Private Helicopter Transfers across Sacred Cities & Coastal Reserves

Sample Bespoke Itinerary Timeline

•
Day 01 - 02

The Ancient Cultural Triangle & Sigiriya

Arrive in luxury with private chauffeur transit to a secluded jungle villa. Ascend the ancient Sigiriya fortress at sunrise before private crowds arrive, followed by an artisan pottery workshop.

•
Day 03 - 04

Mist-Covered Tea Highlands & Colonial Estates

Board the scenic private train or helicopter to Nuwara Eliya. Stay in a century-old planter bungalow, enjoying high-tea and private tea factory harvesting.

•
Day 05 - 06

Wild Leopard Safaris in Yala National Park

Check into a luxury safari camp on the park border. Guided by expert naturalists, track Sri Lankan leopards, wild elephant herds, and rare endemic birds.

•
Day 07

Southern Coastal Sunset & Farewell

Unwind at a private cliffside resort overlooking the Indian Ocean. Enjoy a private seafood dining experience prepared by your dedicated personal chef.
